test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

My friend said to me, “Do you know the recipe of mango ice-cream?”

options.text: My friend asked me that I knew the recipe of mango ice-cream.
My friend asked me if I know the recipe of mango ice-cream.
My friend asked me if I knew the recipe of mango ice-cream.
My friend asked me that I know the recipe of mango ice-cream.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** My friend asked me if I knew the recipe of mango ice-cream.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"Do you know the recipe of mango ice-cream?" becomes "if I knew the recipe of mango ice-cream"**
 
 
• Direct question "Do you know" is converted to indirect question "if I knew."
 
• Pronoun &
